items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: and Mike Jackson brought in songs to me.

ctx.x: I introduced it. I introduced it. Brought it on a piece of brown paper like you wrap groceries in, you know? And then Porter Granger, he came in with songs like "Michigan Water Tastes Like Sherry Wine," and Mike Jackson brought in songs to me. And, well, different ones, different people.
